description: Scale, shear, rotate, move or transform items by exact amounts around a reference point, optionally on a copy (Object > Transform > Scale, Rotate, Shear and Move dialogs; Rotate, Scale, Shear and Free Transform tools; Transform panel)

copy.description: Transform copies and leave the originals in place (the dialogs' Copy button)

each.description: Transform each item around its own reference point instead of the items together as one selection (default false)

matrix.description: A transformation matrix [a, b, c, d, tx, ty] applied in pasteboard coordinates; tx and ty in mm

move.description: Move by an offset: { x, y } in mm (Horizontal / Vertical) or { distance, angle } (mm, degrees counter-clockwise from the right)

x.description: Horizontal offset (mm, positive to the right)

moveContent.description: Move only each frame's content, not the frame (Move dialog > Move Content)

redefineScaling.description: Afterwards, apply the items' scaling to them and show it as 100% (Transform panel menu > Redefine Scaling as 100%)

referenceAt.description: A fixed reference point on a page instead of a point of the bounding box (as when clicking with the Rotate, Scale or Shear tool): { pageIndex, x, y }, all required

pageIndex.description: Page the point is measured on (0-based)

x.description: mm from the left edge of the page

y.description: mm from the top edge of the page

referencePoint.description: Reference point on the bounding box that stays fixed (the reference point proxy); default center

scale.description: Scale proportionally (%), frame and content together

scaleX.description: Horizontal scale (%), frame and content together (Scale X)

scaleY.description: Vertical scale (%), frame and content together (Scale Y)

shearAngle.description: Shear angle (degrees), as in the Shear dialog

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: transform_items
title: Transform Items
